matching_policy.automatic_match: official CAA ICAO identifier, or compatible exact normalized name with a unique OSM candidate
matching_policy.lga_councilor_export: supporting evidence only, not facility data
matching_policy.low_confidence_fuzzy_match: disabled; candidates are emitted for review
matching_policy.nearby_osm_duplicate_handling: collapse node/way representations only when same-island and near-coincident
matching_policy.population_attachment: P5 island records attach by unique official island name; P3 and P6 records remain explicitly unmatched or reviewable when no exact island exists
